objectiveEn: Kill Droajam, Mage of the Sands in the Poisoned Outcrops .
walkthroughEn: The best way to kill the Mage of the Sands is to head straight for him and attack him with everything you have. If you try to pick off the creatures immediately around him his group could quickly overwhelm your party.

objectiveEn: Kill Royen Beastkeeper in Nahpui Quarter of Kaineng City .
walkthroughEn: From Senji's Corner , walk out the southern exit into Nahpui Quarter (explorable area) . Follow the path as indicated on the map. (Directly under the Q in "Nahpui Quarter" on the map, be careful for an over-aggro of Jade Brotherhood, especially if using heroes and henchmen.) When fighting Royen, you may want to move up on the hill above him to remove his damage bonus due to his elevation, but, his skills are all pet based so the elevation bonus only applies to his auto-attacks.

objectiveEn: Kill the Eldritch Ettin in the Bloodstone Caves .
walkthroughEn: As per the Crystal Method walkthrough .

objectiveEn: Kill a Vengeful Aatxe in the Underworld .
walkthroughEn: Vengeful Aatxe are impervious to virtually all forms of damage and cannot be targeted by skills or attacks, but are killed automatically upon the death of their Keeper of Souls . As such, for practical purposes, the quest calls for the killing of a Keeper of Souls.

objectiveEn: Kill Fronis Irontoe in his lair .
walkthroughEn: The easiest way to receive credit for this quest is to receive Kilroy Stonekin 's buff, "Kilroy Stonekin" , and run past all of the enemies directly to Fronis Irontoe. You can bypass the final blockade by staying to the right side.

objectiveEn: Kill Urgoz in Urgoz's Warren .
walkthroughEn: As per the Urgoz's Warren mission.

objectiveEn: Kill Fenrir in Norrhart Domains .
walkthroughEn: Leave Gunnar's Hold into Norrhart Domains and travel west. Continue to proceed to the cave system that is marked with the Warning to Travelers sign. Once inside the cave you will find Fenrir directly to the left - surrounded by Kveldulf .

objectiveEn: Kill Selvetarm and accompanying foes in Slavers' Exile .
walkthroughEn: As per the Selvetarm portion of The Last Hierophant quest.

objectiveEn: Kill Mohby Windbeak in the Gyala Hatchery .
walkthroughEn: Enter from Leviathan Pits . Go towards the gate where the Outcasts and Luxons are fighting. You can try to slip by them while they fight, but in hard mode the Outcasts kill the Luxons quite quickly. After you pass the gate, take the left side of the fork and hug the hillside going northwest. Then go towards the massive jade wave - there are many north-south groups with overlapping patrol paths along the way that can be avoided, or farmed for reputation (approximately 60 enemies, including 4 bosses). Be aware of over-aggroing as new patrols arrive. From there you will be able to scout out the boss patrolling along the jade. Try to pull foes away first as they may get aggroed while you fight the boss.

objectiveEn: Kill a group of Charged Blackness in the Underworld .
walkthroughEn: When you enter the Underworld, you'll arrive at the yellow spot on the map. Finish the first part of Clear the Chamber to open the doors, then proceed south towards Twin Serpent Mountains . Until then, you will mostly encounter warrior foes.

objectiveEn: Kill Rotscale in Majesty's Rest .
walkthroughEn: See Rotscale .

objectiveEn: Kill Zoldark the Unholy in the Vloxen Excavations .
walkthroughEn: As per Dredging the Depths .

objectiveEn: Kill Korshek the Immolated in Forum Highlands .
walkthroughEn: Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn . There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty , the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.

objectiveEn: Kill Myish, Lady of the Lake in Drakkar Lake .
walkthroughEn: As per Myish, Lady of the Lake .

objectiveEn: Kill Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows .
walkthroughEn: As per Cold Vengeance .

objectiveEn: Kill Kunvie Firewing in the Unwaking Waters .
walkthroughEn: There is an Oni popup group just to the east of Kunvie, so it is important to spawn them separately and kill them well away from any possible aggro . Kunvie and their group hit hard, so make sure that one well-protected party member or a tank takes the multiple Ride the Lightning , and be sure the party is spread out to avoid multiple AoE skills. Also Pain Inverter helps a great deal in killing Kunvie.

objectiveEn: Kill Z'him Monns in Bogroot Growths .
walkthroughEn: As per Tekks's War .

objectiveEn: Kill the Greater Darkness in Ravenheart Gloom .
walkthroughEn: After completing the repeatable quests To the Rescue! , The Rifts Between Us and Deathbringer Company in Ravenheart Gloom, the Greater Darkness will spawn along with two of the Darknesses . They're easy to kill, but will spawn additional foes on death.

objectiveEn: Kill the TPS Regulator Golem in Oola's Lab .
walkthroughEn: Quest involved: Little Workshop of Horrors .

objectiveEn: Kill Plague of Destruction and accompanying foes in Raven's Point .
walkthroughEn: As per Defending the Breach . Note that unlike that quest, you have to defeat all the Destroyers in the final room to finish this (as with spawning the chest ).

objectiveEn: Kill the 3 Darknesses in the Hall of Heroes .
walkthroughEn: See The Darkness (boss) .

objectiveEn: Kill Admiral Kantoh in the Fortress of Jahai .
walkthroughEn: Leave from the Sunspear Sanctuary , through the Command Post into Jahai Bluffs . From there keep going east until you reach the Fortress of Jahai. There are a large number of foes within the fort so it is advised to bring a longbow for pulling . Also area of effect skills are of great use. Skills like Panic , Spiteful Spirit , and Searing Flames can greatly help turn the odds. A minion master is also valuable in taking advantage of the number of corpses, but be careful as they can over aggro . The boss is at the very top of the fort and should not be too much of a problem if your party makes it to him without much difficulty. Speed tip: It is not necessary to fight all the Kournan foe and go to the top of the hill, if you aggro the Admiral from outside the fort - before crossing the bridge. Killing him is possible with skills that will ignore walls. This can avoid 6 or 7 mobs of Kournan.

objectiveEn: Kill Borrguus Blisterbark in Sacnoth Valley .
walkthroughEn: As per Borrguus Blisterbark notes .

objectiveEn: Kill Forgewight in Slavers' Exile .
walkthroughEn: As per The Last Hierophant .

objectiveEn: Kill Baubao Wavewrath in the Undercity .
walkthroughEn: The shortest route would be to enter the Undercity from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) , if unlocked. There are plenty of Kappa surrounding Baubao who use Turtle Shell , so plan accordingly.

objectiveEn: Kill Joffs the Mitigator in Riven Earth .
walkthroughEn: It is highly recommended to bring enchantment removal skills as this boss will use Stoneflesh Aura and Armor of Earth , potentially reducing any damage dealt to him to 0. Also, make sure to space everyone out accordingly as this boss can wipe out your entire party with just one Shockwave if you're balled up. On the other hand, Pain Inverter can cause massive damage to him when he uses Shockwave, so consider bringing a minion master . Bringing a source of the Dazed condition (such as Broad Head Arrow ) is also useful.

objectiveEn: Kill Rragar Maneater in the Depths of Tyria . [ sic ]
walkthroughEn: As per the Veiled Threat quest. At least one party member must have the quest.

objectiveEn: Kill Chung, the Attuned in the Undercity .
walkthroughEn: Head to the Nahpui Quarter outpost and enter the Undercity from Wajjun Bazaar , as Chung is much closer to that exit than the Bukdek Byway exit. Be careful when approaching his spawn location, because he will not appear until you approach his location; and when he does appear, two other groups of Am Fah will also popup for an ambush. These groups can all be pulled separately; there is no need to try to kill everyone at the same time.

objectiveEn: Kill Lord Jadoth in the City of Torc'qua .
walkthroughEn: In the City of Torc'qua , complete the quest The City of Torc'qua to spawn Lord Jadoth . See Mallyx the Unyielding (quest) for tactics against him.

objectiveEn: Kill Nulfastu, Earthbound in Drakkar Lake .
walkthroughEn: See Nulfastu, Earthbound .

objectiveEn: Kill the Iron Forgeman in the Forge Heart .
walkthroughEn: As per The Forge Heart .

objectiveEn: Kill Magmus in the Heart of the Shiverpeaks .
walkthroughEn: He appears in Heart of the Shiverpeaks on your character 's second trip through. Your character must have completed the Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest to reach Magmus. Make sure no one in your party has that quest active, or Cyndr the Mountain Heart will spawn instead.

objectiveEn: Kill Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh in Sparkfly Swamp .
walkthroughEn: Head east from Gadd's Encampment . He patrols in a small area just to the north west of Bloodstone Caves . He is often accompanied by a patrol of raptors. Earthbind , Weakness , "Can't Touch This!" and/or Pain Inverter are particularly effective.

objectiveEn: Kill Jarimiya the Unmerciful in the Vehtendi Valley .
walkthroughEn: Proceed west from Yahnur Market , down the hills, across several bridges and into the plains area near the center of Vehtendi Valley . Note that this boss is near several patrols of other Heket , including other bosses. It is possible to get to this boss while avoiding the other groups.

objectiveEn: Kill Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile .
walkthroughEn: As per The Last Hierophant quest .

objectiveEn: Kill Quansong Spiritspeak in Tahnnakai Temple .
walkthroughEn: Head north through the Tahnnakai Temple explorable area from Zin Ku Corridor . Be prepared for area of effect fire damage from the Temple Guardians around him. If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right , you will only encounter Temple Guardians on your way to Quansong Spiritspeak.

objectiveEn: Kill 2 Stygian Underlords in the Stygian Veil .
walkthroughEn: See Breaching the Stygian Veil .

objectiveEn: Kill Fozzy Yeoryios in Sacnoth Valley .
Kill the Black Beast of Arrgh in the Foundry of Failed Creations
walkthroughEn: As per the Foundry Breakout quest.

objectiveEn: Kill Arachni in the Depths of Tyria . [ sic ]
walkthroughEn: As per Scrambled Reinforcements .

objectiveEn: Kill the four horsemen; Madruk Dhuum , Thul Za Dhuum , Ghozer Dhuum , Kazhad Dhuum in the Underworld .
walkthroughEn: As per the The Four Horsemen quest.

objectiveEn: Kill the Remnant of Antiquities and accompanying foes in the Sepulchre of Dragrimmar .
walkthroughEn: As per The Anvil of Dragrimmar quest.

objectiveEn: Kill Arbor Earthcall in the Morostav Trail .
walkthroughEn: Leave from Durheim Archives , Vasburg Armory or Unwaking Waters (Kurzick) . Even though he appears to be alone, six Wardens of Seasons will popup when you get close to his initial location. However, as he has a larger-than-usual aggro bubble , you can pull him towards you without spawning those Wardens of Seasons.

objectiveEn: Kill 3 Prismatic Oozes in the Depths of Tyria . [ sic ]
walkthroughEn: As per the Watch it Jiggle quest. At least one party member must have the quest in order to get past the locked gate in the dungeon.

objectiveEn: Kill Lord Khobay in the Lake of Fire .
walkthroughEn: As per the quest Khobay the Betrayer .

objectiveEn: Kill Jedeh the Mighty in Crystal Overlook .
walkthroughEn: The recommended way to reach Jedeh is to start from the Mouth of Torment . Take the western exit to the Ruptured Heart and make your way to the portal to Crystal Overlook. There will be a few mobs of Graven Monoliths , Margonites and Giants to defeat or avoid. Once you reach the Overlook, the most direct route to Jedeh is indicated by the blue line on the map. However, this will take you through several groups of Djinn , who can be tough to fight especially in Hard Mode. An alternative that is more time-consuming but less lethal is to turn left after entering the map, and board a Junundu . Go through the sulfurous area in the middle of the map and approach Jedeh from the east rather than the northeast. All the mobs you meet along the way should be small and easily disposed of.

objectiveEn: Kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna in the Archipelagos .
walkthroughEn: The route from Cavalon doesn't require you to fight Ssyn Coiled Grasp . Exit into the Archipelagos and head east, dispatching the first mob of fish that you encounter, then continue until you reach the edge of the map and head south. Now head for the boss, killing the patroling Naga and the two stationary Naga mobs in front of the boss. Engage and kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna to complete the bounty.

objectiveEn: Kill Justiciar Thommis and accompanying foes in Slavers' Exile .
walkthroughEn: Justiciar Thommis is the left most boss on the map. The Stone Summit Warders should be the first target as they have protective wards and can deal massive area of effect damage. The other main target should be Stone Summit Defenders because they have Power Drain and Waste Not, Want Not allowing them to spam protection spells as well as interrupt

objectiveEn: Kill either Harn or Maxine Coldstone in Perdition Rock .
walkthroughEn: Once a player gets in radar range of the spawn point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin patrolling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous mobs . If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of Flesh Golems and Mahgo Hydras that patrol in a circle outside of Ember Light Camp . Your party can stay near the Resurrection Shrine and pull each mob.

objectiveEn: Kill Pywatt the Swift in Alcazia Tangle .
walkthroughEn: The simplest way to reach Pywatt is to leave from Rata Sum via Magus Stones . Use the southeast portal to travel to Alcazia Tangle; Pywatt is just south of the portal in Alcazia Tangle.

objectiveEn: Kill Fendi Nin in the Shards of Orr .
walkthroughEn: As per Lost Souls .

objectiveEn: Kill Mungri Magicbox in Ferndale .
walkthroughEn: Mungri is located close to the Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick) entrance to Ferndale. Note that the area is swarming with Dredge patrols , so advance carefully and pull each group to avoid over aggroing . He is a powerful healer and often has a Dredge Gardener in his mob . Interrupts , skills that punish healing or enchantments are recommended due to the boss's reliance on Life Bond and other enchantments.

objectiveEn: Kill the Priest of Menzies in the Fissure of Woe .
walkthroughEn: As per Army of Darkness walkthrough .

objectiveEn: Kill Ilsundur, Lord of Fire in the Catacombs of Kathandrax .
walkthroughEn: As per Kathandrax's Crusher .

objectiveEn: Kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in Prophet's Path .
walkthroughEn: If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right , you will only encounter Marrow Scarabs , Minotaurs , Rockshot Devourers , and Scarab Nest Builders on your way to Kepkhet Marrowfeast. Hex removal skills are unnecessary, as the aforementioned foes do not cast hexes.

objectiveEn: Kill Commander Wahli in the Barbarous Shore .
walkthroughEn: There are several patrols along the way a few can be avoided, watch out for overlapping patrols. Commander Wahli is surrounded by a huge mob , be prepared to retreat if overwhelmed especially in hard mode. If you resurrect, be careful as another group (including a Corsair boss) patrols very near the closest resurrection shrine to Wahli.

objectiveEn: Kill Kanaxai in the Deep .
walkthroughEn: Completing this quest requires completion of the Deep , an elite mission. See that mission's article for details.

objectiveEn: Kill Khabuus in Bogroot Growths .
walkthroughEn: As per Giriff's War .

objectiveEn: Kill Molotov Rocktail in the Dalada Uplands .
walkthroughEn: As you approach his location, spread out the party , using flags for heroes and henchmen ; Rocktail's siege attack can easily wipe an entire party. That same spike also makes the boss vulnerable to damage reflection skills, especially Pain Inverter .

objectiveEn: Kill 4 Stygian Lords in the Stygian Veil .
walkthroughEn: See Breaching the Stygian Veil and Brood Wars .

objectiveEn: Kill a Dragon Lich in the Great Battle Field .
walkthroughEn: A Dragon Lich is found in the Fissure of Woe guarding the entrances of the Shadow Army encampment at the Great Battle Field.

objectiveEn: Kill Havok Soulwail in Darkrime Delves .
walkthroughEn: The walkthrough is the same for the quest The Misanthropic Jotun Principle given by Einarr Frostcleft in Bjora Marches just west of the entrance to the Darkrime Delves. If you enter without the quest, the door inside will be shut. Einarr and another Norn will follow you during the quest but don't help.

objectiveEn: Kill Ghial the Bone Dancer in the Xaquang Skyway .
walkthroughEn: Exit from the Marketplace into Bukdek Byway and then enter Xaquang Skyway or exit from Senji's Corner and head north. See maps for directions. The route from the Marketplace to Ghial is faster as your party will encounter fewer foes than the route from Senji's Corner; however, Senji's Corner has a wider selection of henchmen .

objectiveEn: Kill Murakai, Lady of the Night in the Cathedral of Flames .
walkthroughEn: See the Temple of the Damned walkthrough for information on reaching Murakai, Lady of the Night and for tips on defeating her.

objectiveEn: Kill Rand Stormweaver and accompanying foes in Slavers' Exile .
walkthroughEn: As per Justiciar Thommis' level . Both Rand Stormweaver and the small group directly around him must be killed.

objectiveEn: Kill Verata in Kessex Peak .
walkthroughEn: See the "Notes" sections of Verata the Necromancer and Kessex Peak .
